notes.title: Dystopika, Cities Skylines' cyberpunk cousin, just dropped a huge new update
notes.notes:
Gorgeous cyberpunk city-builder Dystopika just got a huge new update to celebrate its one year anniversary. Wanting to do "something special," developer Voids Within promises that it "really went to town on this one" - and go to town it did. The update (titled 'Meditations') adds two new districts, a megastructure, weather effects, volumetric lighting, lighting props, and an improved photo mode, to name just a few of the additions.

notes.title: A Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/f19e41fe5a5737ecf584b165a1bc4b4291801eed.gif[/img]

Hey everyone! I wanted to share an update to Dystopika's post-launch roadmap. 

Firstly, [b]Mod Support[/b] is being prioritized over the planned Photo Mode enhancements. This will be a big project, but I feel will be more exciting for the community. 

There is demand for so many new buildings, props, and districts that it is far bigger than anything I could make on my own, so I want to put that into modders hands as soon as possible. 

Secondly, I'm adjusting the release cadence. Packing many new features developed over several weeks into a single release created a lot of friction in the testing. 

As a result, I've re-organized the roadmap into approximate timelines rather than grouping by version number. I'd like to return to smaller but more frequent, focused updates where small features can ship when they are ready instead of waiting on being bundled with a "big update". 

I'm really excited about these changes and some of the work happening behind-the-scenes right now (like dynamic sky). 

As always, I'm grateful as hell to this community, the things you create, and the kindness you have shown me and each other. 

Let's keep this update train rolling!
[b]Matt[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/1909fcec55ef42dca3f2bb2742d0ce21d1389f70.png[/img]

notes.title: Dystopika is 2024's most underrated city builder, and it just got a huge update
notes.notes:
What frustrates you the most in Cities Skylines 2? For some players, it's getting taxes absolutely right. In other cases, optimizing garbage collection and building the perfect road network are a constant bane. Obviously you want a challenge in a strategy game, but there's also something to be said for sitting back and just admiring your creation, those reflective moments in Civilization 6 or Age of Empires where you just bask in the majesty of what you've made. Take that feeling and combine it with Night City from Cyberpunk 2077 - eliminate all the headaches from CS2, and indulge, fully, in the joys of architecture and urban design. This is Dystopika, a unique city builder that you have to play, especially now it's had a huge update.

notes.title: An Update on 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello friends, I may have cooked too much. 

1.1 has become bigger than I had originally planned and it needs just a little more time to simmer. 

However, I think you will be very happy with the expanded 1.1 update which now includes new content on top of the planned Quality of Life updates for billboards, custom neons, flying traffic, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/00b518d63144511909b49c6e47f3462df163344e.gif[/img]

[h2]Highways[/h2]
The [url=https://discord.gg/3Zt5YEywZn]Discord[/url] [i]Road Warriors[/i] have been heard loud and clear and [b]highways are coming to Dystopika 1.1[/b]. Highways can be adjusted to create the bends and curves your dystopian heart desires. You can make roads span the full city or make them weave and duck through each other like a giant web. They are also height-adjustable to make skyways or some Rollercoaster Tycoon-inspired insanity. You can also adjust traffic density and there will be multiple road styles. 

[h2]New Buildings and Props[/h2]
Each district is getting new building types alongside several new props. New creative possibilities! More teases of the new content over the coming weeks. 

[h2]Community Creation Challenges[/h2]
The mod team will be rolling out regular timed theme creation challenge to spark your imagination and creativity. We'll be highlighting the best of the best on various social channels. 

[h2]Community Translation Project[/h2]
1.1 will be including more language options but we will also be opening up the translations to allow for anyone to contribute new languages and suggest changes - with the goal of being able to continuously translate and improve the localization as new features are added. 

[h1]Coming Late September[/h1]
Thank you for your patience, I hope the wait will be worth it. 

I'm not ready to set the exact date yet, but anticipate 1.1 to release during the [b]second half of September. [/b]

notes.title: Massive Demo Update | v0.8 released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/14f1b0599879158a5afb28aa1fb6e4836000db27.jpg[/img]
[h1]Introducing Demo 0.8![/h1]

I have emerged from my game development cave to bring you this VERY loaded update to the demo. I'll be resuming regular demo updates as we charge towards a 1.0 release in the near future. 

A lot has changed, so please come and take an updated look at this relaxing cityscaper set in the not-to-distant future. 

This is a chonker. Here are the highlights.

[h2]Prop System.[/h2]
Place billboards, holograms, skyways, smoke stacks, and other items.

[h2]Simplified and Traditional Chinese Localization[/h2]
The first of several localizations available at launch.

[h2]Loading and Saving. [/h2]
Your cities are no longer lost to time. Also an option to enter a World Seed.

[h2]Improved billboards.[/h2]
Now with multiple sizes, and you can right click to cycle through the available images at that size. XL Billboards!

[h2]Bridges and Connections.[/h2]
Buildings now connection horizontally in the right conditions. 

[h2]Hologram emitters.[/h2]
Included in the props, you can now right click to cycle through the options. No more RNG whale hunting! (for now)

[h2]City Settings.[/h2]
Permanently set Time of Day and Weather. (Soon: apply photo mode settings permanently via City Presets)

[h2]Alternate Soundtrack.[/h2]
Flip between two incredible soundtracks in City Settings.

[h2]Procedural Landscapes.[/h2]
Surrounding mountains now generated per city for a unique landscape. More landscape features to come.

[h2]UI Scaling. (Beta) [/h2]
4K-havers, consider yourselves heard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/1d20b5a1cabc16fed92d9b6b8a07f674f4867207.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo Update | v0.5.5 released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/6dc5b00c2741b727158f68171cf1b8d854994893.jpg[/img]

Steam NextFest has come and gone. I want to thank the community for being so enthusiastic, positive, and constructive about Dystopika. It's been amazing to see creations every day in the Discord - often doing things I didn't even know was possible! 

I'll be returning to my dev cave soon to implement the feedback and chart a course for a release. More content and more control has been heard loud and clear. 

As a thank you to the community, I'll be keeping the demo available until [b]Monday, February 26th[/b] and I have put together one final update with some community requests.

[h1]Demo 0.5.5 (02/18/2024)[/h1]

[h2]Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Omega Synthetics corporate pyramid will now spawn under certain conditions
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pressing F3 will hide the UI until F3 is pressed again OR the menu is accessed 
[*] Photo Mode now has a tool to create moving drone shots to assist with video capture with external tools (e.g. OBS)
[*] Photo Mode screenshot button will now take an HD screenshot at double the current resolution up to 4K, pending future setting to control output screenshot resolutions. This allows ultrawide screenshots as well. 
[*] Added a Rain Intensity slider to Photo Mode. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a Loading check to ensure successful startup before proceeding to load game assets. Should help prevent crashes on some systems where Unity's audio system needs some extra startup time (i.e. bluetooth headphones)
[*] Fixed a bug where rapid Undo/Redo would break construction animations
[*] Fixed a bug where spamming Delete tool would cause game breaking issues. 
[*] Tile rotation tool now always anchored on the tile's midpoint regardless of height
[/list]
